wording: P97 argues that 'fitness decoupling' between particles and collectives in an evolutionary transition in individuality (ETI) is a metaphor with limits: computed commensurably over equivalent time intervals, particle and collective fitness are the same once a stable collective size distribution is reached. Instead it proposes that early stages of ETIs involve tradeoffs among particle traits and later, critical stages their rupture ('tradeoff breaking'), which could be used to detect an ETI. In its projection model the optimum for counterfactual fitness f2 is always zero investment in collective survival, while the optimum for whole-life-cycle fitness is positive.
